comment:
Read at commit cb66598. Five commits carry 2.0.2 — 5a9e123, 8e618a4, dc81478, f3094e1 and cb66598 — and they differ in behaviour: dc81478 added the configInput/configOutput names, f3094e1 added the Spread tuning menu, cb66598 added E340::onReset. The installed build has E340::onReset, which only exists from cb66598, and the Spread tuning menu with its Fourths and Fifths choices. So HEAD is what shipped.

The DSP is not vendored. Despite being a licensed port of Synthesis Technology hardware, the whole oscillator is written out in src/E340.cpp, derived from Fundamental's VCO (the file says so at :12); only the panel graphics are Synthesis Technology's, per LICENSE.md. So every figure quoted above is from source, not from the hardware manual.

Three places where the hardware manual does not describe this build, and the line says so in each case:
- FINE. The manual says '~0.5 octaves'. configParam runs -1 to +1 (:232) and the value is divided by 12 (:283), so it is one semitone either way, a sixth of what the manual gives.
- CHAOS BW. The manual says the bandwidth changes 'in 6 steps'. The knob is continuous and the corner is 0.1 * (x+1)^6 (:301), so the six is an exponent here, not a number of steps.
- SYNC. The manual gives a threshold of '+0.25V'. The code detects an upward crossing of zero (:118-122), with no threshold at all.

A fourth disagreement is left out of the lines because it is about loudness rather than a control: the manual says fewer VCOs are louder, because the hardware attenuates as VCOs are added. The port divides the sum by the VCO count in both cases (:155, :174), so all three DENSITY settings come out at the same nominal level.

The manual's claim that sync resets both outputs to -5V is not what the code does either — saw(0) is 0, not -1 — but nothing is claimed about it in the lines.

The manual also describes a trim pot on the circuit board for 1V/octave tracking and a set of unused jumpers. Neither exists here.

SPREAD is cubed (:289) and the spread tunings are ±21, ±9, ±3 and ±15 semitones in Fourths and ±24, ±12, -5/+7 and -17/+19 in Fifths (:52-63), so at full spread the widest pair is 21 semitones either side of centre in Fourths and 24 in Fifths. With DENSITY at 2 only the first pair is used, which is the widest one.

The panel prints the DENSITY positions 8, 4 and 2 from top to bottom; the switch comes up at the top, on 8 (:237).

There are no lights and no hidden controls: seven params, six inputs and two outputs, all with a widget and all tagged.
